test_title: PYST 30: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'SOUND' is coded as '219' and 'BRICK' is coded as '172'. How will 'SLACK' be coded in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 

Logic: Addition of alphabet positional value × number of consonant.

'SOUND' is coded as '219' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59d046d6388afa5e0086e42ee9227ab5dc0b5e2f763165f488a2c5169d3cdd07.png] 

→ Number of consonant → 3

→ 19 + 15 + 21 + 14 + 4 = 73 × 3 = 219

And

'BRICK' is coded as '172'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac28f4ea1c7012642e01f3fae9142abc0a535bfa53c5cb0d647c4eda5b29fed5.png] 

→ Number of consonant → 4

→ 2 + 18 + 9 + 3 + 11 = 43 × 4 = 172

Similarly

'SLACK' be coded as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e655ee736e3c9919e2c70332f2fb87bef06e119462997f5bede64a95612f0dd.png] 

→ Number of consonant → 4

→ 19 + 12 +1 + 3 + 11 = 46 × 4 = 184

Hence, the correct answer is "184".
